# Typography

IBM Plex Sans variable (weight), for the interface; Archivo variable (weight and width), for display headings.

Sources acquired 7 November 2026:
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ibmplexsans
- https://github.com/IBM/plex
- https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/archivo
- https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Archivo

Both fonts use SIL Open Font License 1.1. The corresponding license files are included. The web files are unchanged official Google Fonts WOFF2 Latin and Latin Extended releases, with variable weight and the supplied Archivo width axis. Fonts are self-hosted; no external font request is made by the application. No local subsetting or renaming of the font files is used.

IBM Plex Sans and Instrument Sans were compared at the same sizes in shipment, metric, status and table samples. Plex was retained for its distinguishable letterforms, readable numerals and industrial character; Archivo provides a separate compact heading voice. Instrument Sans was not shipped.

Official webfont source query:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wdth,wght@62..125,100..900&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wdth,wght@100,100..700&display=swap
